messages:
tina-finance: FYI we just got a dispute notice from the acquirer for acct_4412. Customer says multiple unauthorized charges over a short window. Bank placed a temporary payout hold. Need evidence & quick take.

joe-payments: What txns? Ill grab logs and AVS/CVV.

tina-finance: TX-A1, TX-A2, TX-A3. Dates: 2026-03-20 11:02-11:12 UTC. Total $2,750. Customer email on file billing@novum.co.

fraud-bot: AUTOMATED: score=0.88, velocity=MEDIUM, ip_reputation=SUSPICIOUS, device_new=TRUE, note=possible card-testing pattern. Recommend: REVIEW + HOLD_PAYOUTS.

nina-cs: Customer replied via support: "I did not authorize these charges. Please refund immediately." They've opened a bank dispute already.

joe-payments: Quick artifacts:
```
mask_pan,txn_id,amount,country,auth
**** **** **** 1111,TX-A1,500,US,OK
**** **** **** 1111,TX-A2,1250,US,OK
**** **** **** 1111,TX-A3,1000,US,OK
```
Also see 18 auth attempts earlier that failed (suspected testing). Uploading logs to S3.

joe-payments: Uploaded: https://internal-s3/redwood/chargebacks/1902401111/logs.zip (restricted)

tina-finance: Noted that invoice 2026-03-20-4412 auto-renewed. Usage spikes around 11:00 UTC for concurrent model runs. Owner last login 03-19.

fraud-bot: Additional signal: same card used across three distinct accounts in our system in past 72h. Cross-account match id=CM-772.

oliver-legal: Before we send to issuer: redact PAN, include timeline, signed TOS, invoices, evidence of account control (login IPs, verification emails). Do not include raw CVV.

nina-cs: I asked customer for a short written confirmation they want a refund and whether they will withdraw dispute if we issue it. Waiting.

joe-payments: My read: high chance of card-testing followed by full charges. Representment possible but evidence weaker if card reused across accounts. Recommend: submit evidence but flag as "merchant cannot prove cardholder present" fallback.

tina-finance: Proposed: 1) Submit evidence bundle to contest. 2) Keep payout hold. 3) Offer courtesy credit of $500 if customer signs written pause on dispute. Approve?

oliver-legal: Approve evidence submit. On credit: OK if customer confirms in writing they'll pause dispute. Otherwise do not refund.

nina-cs: Customer sent email: "We didn't authorize. We'll wait for your investigation but not pausing the dispute." They refused to pause.

tina-finance: Given refusal, do NOT issue credit. Joe, proceed with representment with full evidence bundle. Tag me when submitted. Target submit in next 4 hours.

joe-payments: Will submit now. Posting receipt id when done.

fraud-bot: Case updated CB-2026-4412.

tina-finance: Thanks team. If bank pushes for quick refund well escalate to legal.
